modInfo: Tucked in the deep woods near March Ridge, Silent Pines is a forgotten hunting town swallowed by mist and silence. Scattered cabins, overgrown trails, and an eerie stillness make every step feel watched. Supplies are scarce, danger is close, and escape is never guaranteed. Perfect for survivalists who want a lonely, atmospheric challenge where the forest feels alive… and hungry.
